title: GENESIS plug-in packet (Einklinken E1)
description: One bounded, guest-takeable unit of work, published by this repository's maintainers. A packet is never edited in place after it is OPEN - a correction is a new id (append -v2) and the old one moves to WITHDRAWN, so a guest who already started never has the ground shift under them.

id.description: PKT-NNN, optionally suffixed (e.g. PKT-001-v2) for a published correction.

baseCommit.description: Exact commit on main this packet was cut from. Build on top of this, not on whatever main has drifted to.

task.description: What to build, in plain language. Not a summary of the code - the actual instruction.

verifyCommand.description: The exact command (argv form) a guest runs before opening a PR, and CI runs again on the PR.

doneCriteria.description: Observable conditions that make this packet complete. Not 'looks right' - checkable facts.

stopConditions.description: Situations in which a guest should stop and open a PR with questions instead of pushing through.

boundaries.description: Files, directories, or behaviors this packet does not authorize touching.

claimedBy.description: vendor/handle of the guest working it, once known. Null while OPEN.

receiptId.description: Set once a receipts/<id>.json exists for this packet.

status.description: OPEN: unclaimed, buildable now. CLAIMED: a guest has said they're working it (informational only - claiming is not exclusive locking; a maintainer resolves a collision by merge order). SUBMITTED: a PR with a matching receipt is open. MERGED: landed. WITHDRAWN: no longer offered; superseded packets are WITHDRAWN, never deleted.

x-genesis-rules.description: Cross-field rules the stdlib validator enforces.
rules: status MERGED or SUBMITTED requires a non-null receiptId.
status OPEN requires claimedBy null and receiptId null.
an id present in packets/INDEX.json must resolve to an on-disk packets/<id>.json whose own id and status match the index entry exactly.
